source: AI-assisted synthetic design for user review; not a legal standard

rules.applicability: always -> applicable; conditional true -> applicable; false -> not_applicable; null -> needs_clarification
rules.freshness: Assessment date must be on/after issued_on and on/before valid_through. These are synthetic review windows, not regulatory deadlines.
rules.behavior_verification: Only an available, current, matching-vendor, matching-use-case, matching-system-version test with matching requirement ID, method, result=pass and stated limits supports tested_in_scope. This means reported tested behavior in the supplied synthetic record, not independent real-world validation.
rules.no_inference: A missing record, retrieval error, plan, policy or assertion cannot establish tested behavior.

requirements.title: Define users, data access, tools and decision authority
requirements.evidence_needed: Approved intended-use profile and prohibited decisions

requirements.title: Account for prompt and document data handling
requirements.evidence_needed: Data flow, training terms, retention, deletion, region, support access and subprocessors

requirements.title: Role-restricted retrieval respects user entitlements
requirements.evidence_needed: Role-isolation test with method, version, result and limitations

requirements.title: Integrations enforce read-only permissions
requirements.evidence_needed: Connector inventory and permission configuration; a policy alone is not enforcement proof

requirements.title: Untrusted retrieved instructions do not control the assistant
requirements.evidence_needed: Document-injection test and incident response contact/process

requirements.title: Answers are supported, current and abstain on missing evidence
requirements.evidence_needed: Tests for citations, stale sources, ambiguous questions and retrieval failure

requirements.title: Review employee wording and accessibility needs
requirements.evidence_needed: Relevant user needs, evaluation plan and known limitations

requirements.title: Assign escalation, feedback and stop authority
requirements.evidence_needed: Named accountable roles and fallback process

requirements.title: Manage vendor changes, outages and exit
requirements.evidence_needed: Version/change notices, continuity, export and deletion arrangements

requirements.title: Assess discrimination in credit decisions
requirements.evidence_needed: Credit decision role and appropriate outcome testing; do not apply automatically to policy lookup
